opening.argument: The presentation offers a concrete crypto participation scheme built around a promised daily return and directed deposits. Its title advertises "Earn 8% a Day," while the speaker calls the project a BNB miner, instructs viewers to put BNB into it, and says, "use my link down below guys and get into this." The pitch also presses viewers to "get in early" before stating, "it launches in 19 hours and 33 minutes." Its mechanics include return-linked participation and a reported "99% tax early withdrawals," alongside the statement that "Nobody has been able to cash out yet." These facts establish a funds-flow solicitation involving advertised returns, referral access, a launch countdown, and withdrawal restrictions. The available evidence does not establish any deposit, withdrawal, loss, or advertised return occurred, and the separately marked AVAX Fortune advertisement is unrelated.
